text:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation is a technique that
combines information retrieval with large language models.
Documents are divided into smaller chunks. Each chunk
can be converted into an embedding and stored in a vector
database. When a user asks a question, relevant chunks
are retrieved and passed to the language model.

Company Leave Policy

Employees should submit leave requests to their manager.
Leave requests must follow the company's approval process.

Document Ingestion

Document ingestion extracts and prepares text from different
sources for further processing.
